check.release_notes: New front-end lobby based on Minimal Frontline. Gather a party, select an appearance, ready up and let the leader start. Human soldier foreground, compact squad portraits and readable native controls. Only Arena Survival is featured. Matching VS61 required. Title and branding remain provisional.
